column1: # This list was written for HoploDex and is licensed GPL-3.0-only, like the
# rest of the source. No third-party dataset was copied: cartridge names are
# standard designations, and the spellings SAAMI and C.I.P. publish were used
# only as a reference for how a name is written, as with any reference book.
#   rank     commonness in U.S. private collections, 1 = most common
#   name     the spelling the catalog offers and snaps to
#   caliber  the bore class (FR-004a), one of research.md §2's classes
#   aliases  other names collectors write, separated by |. They narrow the
#            suggestion list and derive the caliber, but are never snapped to.
#            An alias covers its same-notation variants (".22 LR" also covers
#            "22LR"), and none is spelled like a class.
